craft_notes: Sthāyin: the announcement (means-less first, exposition promised; FIRST VERSE of the song — plain teacher-voice promise, owner verdict required before treating as house voice). Sanskrit: atha anupāyam eva tāvat vyākhyāsyāmaḥ → L4 keeps first-then-promise. Essence 1 (no-way→expound). Close: expound (the promise, vyākhyāsyāmaḥ, as landing). Rejected: 'method/methodless' — killed: upāya already rendered 'way' across the tantrasara batch, consistency wins; dropping line 2 — killed: the promise is the verse's only verb, L4 must carry it. Read aloud: FIRST-of the FOUR-ways-IN / THE-WAY with-no-WAY / WE-shall ex-POUND-it.

lines: First of the four ways in: the way with no way.

reads_against.argmap: What comes first, and what is promised? → The means-less itself is announced first: exposition promised.
c1_essence: The way with no way: when grace has struck firm, one word from the teacher and the immersion is ever-risen — no means required.
